This is a truthful testimony based on facts.

I had 2 teeth extracted here. They offer free xray up to 1000 baht if you leave them a great review. I think realistic reviews are more valuable for customers, while good reviews only benefit the business.

My extracted tooth sockets were bleeding several days. The dentist did not put stitches in my wounds. I came back next day and the dentist said its alright, just put a sterilized pad on my wound. Meanwhile I had to go to hospital each night due to wound opening and bleeding sgatting again. So all was not alright. Finally I came back very angry and demanded to be stitched. Finally dentist noticed that the sockets weren't clotting properly after 2 days. After being stitched, The bleeding stopped relatively soon. I spent in total over 2000 baht on teeth extraction and over 2000 baht each night to hospital visits (2 nights), because my insurance company did not cover it. Why they did not stitch initially? They said the wound is less than 1 centimeter. Still I read online that each wound from extracted tooth should generally be stitched. Also, I would hope that the male dentists would use terminology that is not suggestive depending on the context, such as: "Swollow, dont split" (when talking about blood in throat) and "Don't suck" (apparently referring to the tooth socket).

I have learned my lesson. I will never return to this dental place.

Edit 1: The post dental treatment instruction mentioned antibiotics; yet the dentist did not prescribe them to me. I had fever on numerous occasions after extraction, particularly after stitching.
